title: GPU Management: Why Idle GPUs Are the New Grounded Aircraft
summary: The article discusses the growing problem of idle GPUs in data centers, comparing them to grounded aircraft that incur costs without generating value. It highlights the inefficiencies in current GPU management practices, the financial and environmental impact of underutilized hardware, and proposes strategies for better scheduling, sharing, and monitoring to maximize GPU utilization.
highlights: Idle GPUs represent a significant financial drain, akin to grounded aircraft that still incur costs.
Current GPU management often leads to underutilization, with many GPUs running at low occupancy rates.
Implementing dynamic scheduling and workload sharing can dramatically improve GPU efficiency.
Better monitoring and predictive analytics are essential to identify and reduce idle time.
Optimizing GPU usage not only cuts costs but also reduces the environmental footprint of data centers.

title: The OlmoEarth Platform: Geospatial inference at planetary scale
summary: OlmoEarth is a geospatial inference platform by AI2 that enables planetary-scale analysis by combining satellite imagery, location data, and large language models. It provides tools for building and deploying geospatial AI models, with a focus on scalability, accessibility, and real-world applications.
highlights: OlmoEarth enables geospatial inference at planetary scale.
It integrates satellite imagery and location data with large language models.
The platform is designed for scalable and accessible geospatial AI applications.
